text.p: Factfile on Christain Vieri, who
joined Atletico Madrid from Juventus on Wednesday for 34 billion
lire ($20 million):
July 12, 1973 - Born in the northern city of Bologna.
Subsequently brought up in Australia.
1989 - Makes his professional debut for serie C side Prato
1990 - Moves to Torino, where he makes his serie A debut on
December 15, 1991 in a 2-0 defeat of Fiorentina.
November 1992 - Moves to serie B side Pisa after failing to
establish himself at Torino, where he made only seven league
appearances in just over two seasons.
1993 - Moves to Ravenna (serie B).
1994 - Moves to Venice (serie B).
1995 - Moves to Atalanta, where he finally establishes himself
as a serie A player. Scores seven goals in his one season there.
1996 - Moves to Juventus for seven billion lire shortly after
their European Cup triumph as a replacement for Gianluca Vialli.
Starts the season as understudy to Alessandro Del Piero and
Croat Alen Boksic. When Boksic is injured, seizes his chance to
partner Del Piero. Juventus go on to win the league title and reach the European Cup final.
March 29, 1997 - Receives his first full cap for Italy, scoring their 1,000th international goal on his debut against Moldova in
a World Cup qualifier. Goes on to win three more caps before the
end of the season.
July 2, 1997 - Leaves Juventus for Spain's Atletico Madrid for
34 billion lire ($20 million).
